Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders

After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.desc: Sing along to Baby John's favorite animal songs! First, the kids welcome a new puppy named Bingo to the family and sing the classic nursery rhyme about him! Finally, Slick and Newt go on a date, but things don't go as planned when Newt is infected by a werewolf!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Bubbles is having an out-of-this-world day! An eclipse is forecast, and when her friends mysteriously start to disappear, Bubbles believes aliens are behind the abductions! programme.desc: Get ready for giant bubbles and science with Meekah! First, she visits Bubble Pop to learn the science behind bubbles. She builds a bubble tower, has a dance party and even stands inside a giant bubble! Then, Meekah explores water science and physics through active play. She experiments with sounds at a water table, learns about levers by lifting a car and tinkers with small objects to build huge structures!

She climbs play structures, goes down slides and even tests her ninja skills in the ninja course! Along the way, she meets some special dino friends! Then, Explorer Meekah searches for shapes and learns about the different balls used in sports. She goes around the indoor playground discovering new ways to bounce, roll and dunk them!

programme.title: Blippi

Then he teams up with NBA player Andre Drummond, where they agree to trade skills-Andre teaches Blippi basketball and Blippi teaches Andre how to be more like Blippi!

programme.title: Blippi

The first leg of the journey proves to be an incredible challenge, but the difficulty skyrockets when a surprise dinosaur stampede breaks out. The entire team must spring into action to handle the dino-sized roadblock, round up the herd, and get their massive adventure back on track.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch

Stranded on the side of the road, the ranchers must become master mechanics, working together to diagnose and fix their vehicles. It's a race against time to solve the strange breakdowns and get their precious prehistoric cargo back on the road to their new home.

They learn about bike wheels and decorate helmets before hitting the road for an amazing bike ride.

programme.title: Blippi

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange day for the Oddbods! When Zee is caught 'borrowing' electricity from Jeff, Jeff makes him clean up his messy house as payment. Then, Slick and Pogo get into a battle of 'one-upmanship' over who is the neighborhood's resident superhero, but their competition is less than heroic. The day gets even stranger when Newt finds a four-leaf clover and has an amazing run of good luck!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Pogo finally meets his match when he annoys an equally annoying and determined bird species called a 'Twitcher.' Then, when a highly infectious fever hits the cul-de-sac, Zee finds himself playing nurse to all his friends, who display a variety of extreme symptoms. Finally, Jeff accidentally causes Pogo to crash-land, causing him to lose his memory, and Jeff decides to rehabilitate him.

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures

It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi and his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he and D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made and join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.desc: Join Joey and Boo in a series of adventures where everything goes wrong! First, Joey plans the perfect birthday party for Boo, only to forget her present at the last minute! The bad luck continues as Joey gets stuck to the back of a spider, they get encased in cement while chasing a berry and they are accidentally rolled up inside a meatball by a dung beetle!

It's a story about discovery, teamwork, and enjoying the sweet tastes of spring.

In the process of defending her, Karim learns uncomfortable secrets about his missing wife and child that may cause him to lose everything. A gory bloodfest that interweaves politics, greed, black magic, decapitation and dismemberment, and demon possesions, this horror film is loosely based on the real and gruesome murder of politician, Datuk Mazlan Idris, by Mona Fandey, a washed-up singer-turned-witch doctor who was convicted in 1993. Originally slated for release in 2007, its controversial subject matter forced the film into cold storage, until it was finally shown in 2018.

The three of them rent a house from Pak Cik Osman but they are three months behind in rent. One day, Pak Cik Osman's nephew Saipol, an illegal motor racer, comes to put with them for a while. That night, Saipol wins a race and goes home with RM10,000 in cash on him. Rudy so happens to get home at the same time, still in his vampire costume. Saipol is so frightened that he has a heart attack and dies on the spot. Akhiruddin and Remy follow behind and the three bachelors start panicking over what to do with Saipol's corpse. Will Saipol come back to haunt them and get back the money?
